lines: My flower was blooming, my outlook was shining, but
The sun was shaded, and they all vanished in the dark
The dream spat lies and left me behind
It left loneliness behind, a dawn I wandered into
I need nothing If only they'd come back
My everything, my everything that I had loved
Where's everything? Give me an answer
Before I knew it, even my tears had withered
Because the world I loved is nowhere now
I still remember the old days, my beautiful memories, but
Now they torment me, more than anything else
Memory betrays and tears me apart
There is not even a single thing I cherish left
Stay by my side If you are still alive
My everything, my everything that I embraced
If it can't be granted, I won't wish any more
Even discard hope
If I could just disappear...
If this pain were to last forever
If the blazing sunset were to set
We'll return together to the bottom of that sea
Ah, coldness and silence to my burning heart
Oh nostalgic world
It wrapped all of me
My everything, my everything that I have loved
Where's everything?
No more answer needed
I gently closed my eyes forever as if sleeping
Holding the world I loved in my chest
